root_cause.text: During XLAT IPv4/IPv6 protocol translation of GRO packets with a frag_list, only the head skb's header is translated, leaving the frag_list skbs with untranslated headers, causing skb_segment_list to produce incorrect segments and degrade throughput.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states that "skb_segment_list cannot correctly process GRO skbs that have been converted by XLAT, since XLAT only translates the header of the head skb. Consequently, skbs in the frag_list may remain untranslated." The patch sets SKB_GSO_DODGY on GSO packets in XLAT helpers (bpf_skb_proto_4_to_6 and bpf_skb_proto_6_to_4) and adds checks `!(skb_shinfo(skb)->gso_type & SKB_GSO_DODGY)` in tcp4_gso_segment, __udp_gso_segment, and tcp6_gso_segment to skip the frag_list segmentation path when the flag is set, forcing fallback to skb_segment.
